cache_model_predictions: cache model predictions from a PyTorch model over a data loader and return concatenated results
gather_tensors_to_cpu: gather all GPU tensors in a predictions dict to CPU and compute their cache size in GB
concatenate_cache_batches: concatenate a list of batched tensors, dicts, or numpy arrays into a single batched tensor
review_cache_preds_module: review the cache_preds module that caches model predictions with optional variable filtering and stats tracking
summarize_gather_all: summarize the gather_all function that recursively moves tensors to CPU and calculates cache memory size
